speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you tell me exactly when these gait and limb ataxia symptoms began, and have you noticed any other neurological changes such as slurred speech or double vision?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: I see. Given the asymmetry of your symptoms, has this onset been sudden, occurring over hours or days, or has it been a gradual progression over weeks and months?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is a crucial piece of information. Have you experienced any recent infections, fevers, or changes in your bowel habits recently, and are you currently experiencing any vision changes or numbness elsewhere in your body?

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had a recent fever or major infection that I know of. The symptoms are mostly gait imbalance, limb ataxia, and weaker use of my right arm.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of Crohn's disease and natalizumab use, I am concerned about Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). REQUEST TEST: Brain_MRI_with_contrast
